column4: const useStore = create((set) => ({ count: 0, increment: () => set(state => ({ count: state.count + 1 })) }))

column2: Paano gamitin ang Zustand store sa component?
column4: const count = useStore(state => state.count); — i-select lang ang kailangan para sa performance

column2: Paano mag-setup ng Redux Toolkit slice?
column4: const counterSlice = createSlice({ name: 'counter', initialState, reducers: { increment: state => state + 1 } });

column2: Kailan pumili ng Zustand vs Redux vs Context?
column4: Zustand: simple, boilerplate-free. Redux: complex, maraming features. Context: basic sharing, no library needed.

column2: Paano i-migrate mula sa useState papunta sa Zustand?
column4: I-move ang state sa create() store, i-access gamit ang useStore() hook sa halip na useState
